theory.heading: What AI System Design and Capstone is
theory.body: AI System Design and Capstone describes the methods and patterns used within AI Engineering to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: AI System Design and Capstone is a named, repeatable concept.
It has a clear purpose and scope.
It connects to other course topics.

theory.heading: Why AI System Design and Capstone matters
theory.body: Without AI System Design and Capstone, systems built with AI Engineering are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How AI System Design and Capstone works
theory.body: The mechanism behind AI System Design and Capstone follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of AI System Design and Capstone.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of AI System Design and Capstone
theory.body: AI System Design and Capstone offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
